name: How long does it take to install new bathroom vanities and kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new bathroom vanities and kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of vanity and cabinet installation depends on the scope and complexity of the project. A single bathroom vanity might be installed in a day, while a full kitchen cabinet replacement could take several days to a week. Factors like cabinet type, room size, and any necessary plumbing or electrical work influence the timeline. We provide a projected timeline after assessing your project to give you a clear expectation of the completion date.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies by project size and complexity, from a day for a single vanity to a week for full kitchen cabinets.
